bibl.title: Iconography of the Lighthouse in Roman Antiquity: Symbolism, Identity and Power Across the Mediterranean.
bibl.seg: Federico Ugolini, Iconography of the Lighthouse in Roman Antiquity: Symbolism, Identity and Power Across the Mediterranean.
Martin Henig & Jason Lundock (edd.), Water in the Roman World: Engineering, Trade, Religion and Daily Life = Archaeopress Roman Archaeology. 91 (Oxford, 2022) pp. 6-25, figg.
bibl.note: Premise. - An insight into the textual and historical sources for Roman lighthouses. - Further parallels for the iconography of the Roman lighthouse. - The symbolic significance of the Roman lighthouse in iconography. - Conclusions. - Nombreuses mentions du Phare d'Alexandrie.
